Name: Clean Cellar
Author: Sonozuki
Description:
[size=5][b][color=#ff0000]ABANDONED[/color][/b][/size][size=3]

This mod retextures parts of the cellar and removes the barrels to make it look cleaner and more functional. [/size]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Extra info[/size][list]
[*]To uninstall delete Stardew Valley/Mods/CleanCellar.
[/list]
